channel.title: Gaia's Secret Agents — Printable Family Games and Cards
channel.description: Printable family games, conversation cards and screen-free nature adventures.

item.title: Outdoor Family Activities: More Wonder, More Time Together
item.description: Make family time an adventure. Slow down, look closely and share what you discover outdoors. Gaia’s Secret Agents offers screen-free nature missions for curious families. Start with the free printable secret-agent mission; a parent or guardian email is required. Save this for your next family adventure.

media:content.media:description: A family sits beneath a tree under a starry sky with the words More Wonder. More Together.

item.title: Printable Family Conversation Cards for Kids Who Like to Pass
item.description: How do you include someone who would rather listen? In the 16-card Founding Pack, everyone can talk, imagine, act or pass. Set aside 10–20 minutes for a Secret Meeting with children and grown-ups. See the printable Founding Pack.

media:content.media:description: Three enamel mugs sit beside illustrated cards on a sunlit table. Text highlights the option to pass.

item.title: Family Traditions Ideas: A Secret Meeting With Grandparents
item.description: What can grandparents and children do together in ten minutes? Draw one printable Secret Meeting Card and take turns talking, imagining or acting. Anyone may pass. Explore the 16-card Founding Pack for a family ritual you can repeat.

media:content.media:description: A silver-haired grandmother and child smile at each other in a sunny garden. Text introduces a family meeting.

item.title: Nature Drawing Game for Kids: Sketch a Clue and Guess
item.description: How can two people turn a nature sketch into a guessing game? Choose a tiny outdoor discovery, sketch it, then describe it without using its name. Let your partner guess. Leave living things where you find them. Try the free Tiny World Hunt.

media:content.media:description: An unfurling fern sits beside a pencil study on warm paper. Text invites a partner to guess the sketch.

item.title: Family Meeting Activity for Kids: Choose One Small Earth Action
item.description: How do you finish a family meeting with something children can do? Choose one small job together, such as checking whether a pot plant needs water. The 16-card Founding Pack includes TALK, IMAGINE and DO prompts and an action sheet. Explore the printable pack.

media:content.media:description: A teal watering can sits beside a golden flowering plant in a cobalt pot on a verandah.

item.title: Free Digital Postcard Maker for Kids and Families: Send a Secret Message
item.description: How can we make a postcard for someone far away? Choose a mission artwork and add a message in the free postcard maker. Your family can download the finished card, and the site says nothing is uploaded to a server. Make a secret postcard.

media:content.media:description: An illustrated postcard with space for a message lies on a coral writing desk beside a pen.

item.title: After-dinner family game: a 10–20 minute Secret Meeting
item.description: What can we play when dinner is over and time is short? The Founding Pack has a guide for a 10–20 minute family meeting. Its 16 printable cards give children and grown-ups a choice of talking, imagining or doing. Explore the Secret Meeting Cards.

media:content.media:description: Three colourful plates and a vase of golden wattle sit on a blue tablecloth.

item.title: Family conversation game: take turns drawing a Secret Meeting Card
item.description: How can everyone have a turn in a family game? Shuffle the Founding Pack, take turns drawing a card and invite everyone to answer, imagine or join in. Anyone may pass. Explore the 16 printable Secret Meeting Cards for children and grown-ups.

media:content.media:description: Three teal and blue chairs circle a small table on a garden verandah.

item.title: Printable family card game with a storage box for all 16 cards
item.description: Where do the Secret Meeting Cards go between games? The Founding Pack includes a printable tuck box to keep its 16 TALK, IMAGINE and DO cards together. The 12-page A4 PDF also includes a meeting guide and an action sheet. Explore the Founding Pack.

media:content.media:description: A plum paper box sits on a teal games shelf beside a wooden die and pencil.

item.title: Family game night: write your own questions for the Secret Meeting deck
item.description: Can our family add its own ideas to the game? The printable Starter Kit includes three write-your-own cards in its 28-card Secret Meeting deck. One question you might invent is “Which tree would you show a visitor?” Explore the Starter Kit.

media:content.media:description: Three blank cream cards fan out beside a teal pen on a violet desk.

item.title: Print-at-home family game: what print setting fits the Founding Pack?
item.description: What setting should I choose for the Secret Meeting Cards? Print the 12-page PDF on A4 paper at 100% or Actual Size. The Founding Pack contains 16 TALK, IMAGINE and DO cards to use together. See the printable Founding Pack.

media:content.media:description: An ivory ruler lies beside blank paper and a blue printer.

item.title: Imagination game for families: tell a tiny adventure together
item.description: How can we get a family story started? Try an opening of your own, such as “If a leaf were our boat, where would we sail?” Let each person add an idea or pass. The Founding Pack includes IMAGINE prompts among its 16 printable cards. Explore the Founding Pack.

media:content.media:description: A golden leaf boat sails between tall reeds on a jewel-blue pond.

item.title: Nature walk thank-you card: make a free digital postcard with your child
item.description: What could my child write to someone who took them exploring? Pick one moment they remember, such as spotting a kookaburra, and thank the person who showed it to them. The postcard maker lets you choose mission artwork, add a message and download the card. Make a free thank-you postcard.

media:content.media:description: A child and an older relative walk along a boardwalk under a pink sky, with a kookaburra overhead.

item.title: Family conversation cards with three ways to play: talk, imagine and do
item.description: Do family conversation cards always ask a question? The Founding Pack mixes TALK, IMAGINE and DO prompts. Your family can tell a story, dream something up or join in an action. Explore the 16-card pack.

media:content.media:description: A yellow-throated toucan sits beside three staggered coloured tabs labelled Talk, Imagine and Do.
